capabilities: Create a note pre-filled with EmDash post fields
Pick a featured image from the vault with thumbnail previews
Post the open note as a draft or published post, re-sending updates the same post
Upload the note's images and set the cover image
Convert headings, lists, callouts, tables, code and other Markdown for the site
extras: The access token is stored in the Obsidian keychain rather than data.json; the keychain is per device, so the token must be entered on each computer and phone. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push a note to an EmDash blog with its images, tags and categories intact.

relations.evidence: Send notes to an EmDash site as blog posts
the site needs the Auto Thumbnail Design plugin

summary: Publishing plugin that sends Obsidian notes to an EmDash site as blog posts, uploading images and mapping tags, categories and excerpts.
